commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' CHANCE! Dango Ouattara (Brentford) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
90+8' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90+6' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+5' Andy Madley blows for a foul after Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+3' Good chance! Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
90+1' Andy Madley rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Vitaly Janelt (Brentford).
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.

90' Romelle Donovan (Brentford) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Nick Pope was alert and the score remains the same.
89' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sandro Tonali leaves the pitch and Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
87' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Kieran Trippier is replaced by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd).
87' Substitution. Mathias Jensen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
86' The attendance for today's match is 52032.
85' 2 - 3 Goal! A great through ball by Mathias Jensen sets up Dango Ouattara (Brentford) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:3.
83' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andy Madley stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
82' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
80' Substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter makes way for Romelle Donovan (Brentford).
79' 2 - 2 Goal! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Caoimhin Kelleher into the bottom right corner.
78' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is going to take the penalty!
78' The Newcastle players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
77' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Newcastle! Let's see what he decides.
76' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
75' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
73' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
72' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Igor Thiago (Brentford) for a tough tackle.
68' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
68' The referee awards a corner and Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.

67' A neat pass is well received by Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
65' A substitution has been made. Yoane Wissa is replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
64' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Andy Madley had a clear view and blows his whistle.
62' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
58' Brentford fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
56' It will be a substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Jordan Henderson walks off.
54' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
53' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is cleared to safety by the defence.
52' The Newcastle players can’t believe it after referee Andy Madley signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

52' Play continues despite the shouts by some Newcastle players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Andy Madley interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Brentford players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
50' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
49' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
48' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Anthony Elanga and Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is off.
46' The game is over for Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd). Nick Woltemade comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Andy Madley couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dango Ouattara (Brentford) and blew his whistle.
45+2' 1 - 2 Goal! Igor Thiago (Brentford) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Nick Pope into the bottom left corner.
45+1' Igor Thiago (Brentford) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Referee Andy Madley is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Brentford!
45+1' Celebrations by Brentford are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Brentford are awarded a penalty!
44' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card for infringement.
41' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
39' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

37' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) makes it 1:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Keane Lewis-Potter and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Nick Pope was helpless.
36' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

36' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Rico Henry (Brentford) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
30' Caoimhin Kelleher leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd).
30' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
29' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Newcastle earn a corner.

29' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
26' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
24' 1 - 0 Bruno Guimaraes sends in a great cross from the corner, finding Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) who outjumps the defence to finish into the top right corner with a header. The score is 1:0.
24' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.
24' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) prepares to take a corner kick.
23' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.

23' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
21' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
21' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
18' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
16' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Nick Pope.
15' Close! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
15' Newcastle fail to score from a corner as Caoimhin Kelleher (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.
14' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Newcastle win a corner.
10' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort goes high over the bar.
6' Brentford take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
4' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd). Andy Madley saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Brentford are awarded a free kick.
3' Ooh that was close! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.

Newcastle will kick the game off.
